name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.8 degrees north of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 23 times in 7 visits over 70 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 48 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.9 days starting 2025-12-01, at wavelengths from 0.84 to 4.60 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
